subject: A question for cpptraj cluster command

messages.author: Yeng-Tseng Wang
messages.body:
Dear all,
I want to calculate the cluster with the two reaction coordinates. (rmsd
and C.M. distance)..But I read the manu and found that the cluster command
only can support the rmsd. Then I used the cluster data command (cluster.in),
it can work with 1 reaction coordinate. If I want to obtain the cluster
information and average structures with the two reaction coordinates. (rmsd
and C.M. distance), cloud you tell how to do ?
Thanks a lot ^^
Yeng-Tseng wang
cluster.in
parm zw.top
trajin XX.x
distance D1 :307 :25-27,41,49,140-145,163-169,189-191 out d.dat
rms rmsd :25-27,41,49,140-145,163-169,189-191&!.H first out rmsd.
dat
cluster data D1 clusters 10 epsilon 4.0 summary summaryd.dat info
infod.dat
cluster data rmsd clusters 10 epsilon 0.5 summary summaryr.dat info
infor.dat
run

messages.author: Daniel Roe
messages.body:
Hi,
On Mon, Jul 5, 2021 at 2:06 PM Yeng-Tseng Wang <c00jsw00.gmail.
com> wrote:
> cluster data D1 clusters 10 epsilon 4.0 summary summaryd.dat info
> infod.dat
> cluster data rmsd clusters 10 epsilon 0.5 summary summaryr.dat info
> infor.dat
If you want to cluster on both sets "D1" *and* "rmsd", you can just
put them in a comma-separated list, e.g.:
cluster data D1,rmsd ...
This will use both data sets in a simple Euclidean way. See the
'cluster' entry in the Cpptraj/AmberTools manual (or type 'help
cluster' in an interactive cpptraj session) for full syntax. Hope this
helps,
-Dan
